The Department of Computer Science at Lipscomb University invites applications for a tenure-track, open-rank faculty position beginning in Fall 2027. We seek a dedicated educator, ideally with expertise in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, who is passionate about teaching, mentoring students, and contributing to our vibrant academic community. This is primarily a teaching-focused position with opportunities for scholarly engagement.
<br><br>
🗓️ Review of applications will begin ***October 1, 2026*** and continue until the position is filled.
